title: Smooth partitions subordinate to an open cover of a closed set
statement: Use $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field]. Let $M$ be a Hausdorff, sigma-compact smooth real manifold modeled on a finite-dimensional real normed vector space (the model may have corners), let $S\subseteq M$ be closed, and let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be any set-indexed family of open subsets with $S\subseteq\bigcup_i U_i$. There exist smooth real functions $\varphi_i$ on $M$ such that $\varphi_i\geq0$, the supports $\{x:\varphi_i(x)\neq0\}$ form a locally finite family, $\sum_i\varphi_i(x)=1$ for $x\in S$, $\sum_i\varphi_i(x)\leq1$ for all $x\in M$, and $\overline{\{x:\varphi_i(x)\neq0\}}\subseteq U_i$ for every $i$. Here locally finite means that every point has a neighborhood meeting only finitely many supports; the sums therefore have only finitely many nonzero terms near each point.
